name: Murd Bugbear

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Your blueish-brown fur helps you blend into swamps, rivers, and coastlines. Your webbed hands and feet enable you to move through those same terrains. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet. Additionally, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to hide or sneak in aquatic environments.
